description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the FuelAutoTune class, verifying its behavior with different data inputs and configuration parameters. It uses JUnit for testing and includes helper methods to create test data and print diagnostic information.

classes.name: FuelAutoTuneTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the FuelAutoTune processing logic, including scenarios for pre-tuned values, optimizing table cells, and auto-tune processes.

methods.name: testAlreadyTuned
methods.description: Tests that the process correctly identifies that the fuel values are already at the target value, asserting no significant adjustments are needed.

methods.name: testOptimizeOneCell
methods.description: Tests the auto-tune process on a uniform fuel table, checking that specific cells are adjusted to expected values.

methods.name: testAutoTune
methods.description: Runs a sequence of auto-tune processing steps with varying data to validate the tuning process and outputs.

methods.name: countNotEqual
methods.description: Counts elements in a 2D array that do not match a specified default value.

methods.name: printNotDefault
methods.description: Prints array elements that differ from a default value for diagnostic purposes.

methods.name: createVeTable
methods.description: Creates a VE (volumetric efficiency) table filled with a specified value for testing.
